brief:
Jason Alexander, best known for his role in the television series Seinfeld, has described a visit to Ramallah that challenged his preconceived fears about Palestinian cities, according to Al Jazeera English. Alexander recounted how residents provided him protection during the trip, which altered his perspective on the region.

The actor said the encounter with Ramallah residents changed his understanding of safety and hospitality in Palestinian territories, shifting anxieties he had held before arriving in the West Bank city.
dek: Seinfeld actor Jason Alexander recalls a visit to Ramallah that challenged his fears about visiting Palestinian cities.
title: Actor Jason Alexander recalls Palestinian protection visit to Ramallah
